headline: Three paths were unreachable on EVERY tier for a reason no decision tree could fix: the model chose scatter, bubble and boxplot correctly and render_chart's input schema refused the call (-32602: every dataset required `data`; these types carry scatterData or samples). The model fell back to line or bar. 53 refused calls in round 1. After making `data` optional: 3/3 in every arm, 0 refusals.

The one real choice problem was polarArea (a weekly cycle): best and no-rules chose bar 6/6, the decision-tree arm polarArea 5/6. With the decision path above the rules, every one of the 14 paths is reached; without it 13.
The per-type rules alone changed nothing measurable here: best and best-no-type-rules reach the same 13 paths (no-rules drew a doughnut once for the pie).

caveats: Pilot: haiku, n=3. A confirmation at n=10 with sonnet is the next step.
